title: I made a word search game where you can race another player live on the same grid. Looking for feedback
author: runicLabs
selftext:
I'm a solo dev and I've been building a word search game for Android. I'd love feedback from people who actually play word games.

What's different about it

1v1 Versus mode: you and a real opponent race on the same grid at the same time. Every word you find is one they can't. You earn trophies and climb through 8 arenas.

Daily Puzzle: one new puzzle a day for everyone (it resets at 00:00 UTC), with a global leaderboard and streak bonuses.

Learn as you play: tap any found word to see what it means. The word bank is about 2,800 words.

4 difficulty levels: from relaxed and untimed up to racing the clock. Words cross each other and run diagonally, so the harder grids actually feel hard.

Stats: streaks, best times, and your match history.

It's free. There are ads, but nothing is pay-to-win.
